items.title: Blessings Hot-Air Balloon Coloring Page
items.alt: Two cheerful cartoon children wave from a woven hot-air-balloon basket beneath a “BLESSINGS” banner in black outline.
items.description: Complete ropes, scalloped swags and the rounded balloon envelope connect the two distinct children to the basket.

items.title: Hedgehog Writing a Blessings Card Coloring Page
items.alt: A smiling cartoon hedgehog writes “BLESSINGS” on a card at a mushroom-shaped desk in black outline.
items.description: A feather pen, small ink bottle and flower pot complete the whimsical seated character scene.
